memo.situation: Kestrel (V2) revised its quote on refresh and now breaches the ₹4.6 Cr ceiling.

memo.reasoning: Recommend O-V3X - Anvil Electric India with expedite (INR 26.0 L): total INR 398.6 L ex-GST, delivery 2027-07-01 (+29 d float), on-time record 90%, score 0.65. Versus O-V1 (Voltaris Switchgear Pvt Ltd, score 0.58): is INR 43.8 L cheaper but has 14 d less float and a 82% vs 90% on-time record. The INR 43.8 L saving buys schedule risk: missing the energisation window delays the data-hall handover, which costs far more than the delta. Rejected O-V2: Kestrel Power Systems rev 2: committed INR 463.8 L (100.8% of budget, breach); delivers 2027-06-17 (+43 d float); on-time record 93%; INFEASIBLE: over budget. Rejected O-V3: Anvil Electric India: committed INR 391.2 L (85.0% of budget, ok); delivers 2027-08-12 (-13 d float); on-time record 90%; INFEASIBLE: misses required-on-site by 13 d.
risks: O-V3X: above the 90% budget warning line - little headroom for variations or copper price movement.
O-V3X: expedite fee INR 26.0 L must be tied to a contractual delivery date with LDs, payable only on milestone.
O-V1: Voltaris Switchgear Pvt Ltd on-time record is 82%; expect expediting effort and weekly progress audits.
